title: Volunteer applications are open
body: We take about 400 volunteers each year across gates, recycling, hospitality, and the Brewers Showcase. Four shifts earns you a festival pass. Applications close August 15 and we fill up early — apply at tellurideblues.com/volunteer.

title: Single-day tickets released
body: A limited block of Friday, Saturday, and Sunday single-day tickets is now available. Three-day passes are still the better value if you are coming for the weekend, and they are the only ticket that includes campground eligibility.

title: Set times are live
body: The full three-day schedule is in the app, including Brewers Showcase sessions and the late-night club shows. Save what you want to see and the app will flag any overlaps for you. Set times can still move — the app updates itself whenever we publish a change.

title: Campground wristband pickup has moved
body: Town Park Campground wristbands are no longer issued at the East Gate. Pick them up at the Box Office on the west side of the park, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM Thursday and Friday. Bring photo ID and your confirmation. If you arrive after 8:00 PM Friday, check in at the Info Booth instead.

title: Gondola running late all three nights
body: The gondola between Telluride and Mountain Village will run until 2:00 AM Friday, Saturday, and Sunday nights so the late-night club crowd can get back. Last car up from Station Telluride leaves at 1:45 AM. It is free, as always.
